cards.name: Into the Roil
cards.oracleText:
Kicker {1}{U} (You may pay an additional {1}{U} as you cast this spell.)
Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If this spell was kicked, draw a card.

cards.name: Into the Night
cards.oracleText: It becomes night. Discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards plus one.

cards.name: Enter the Infinite
cards.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the number of cards in your library, then put a card from your hand on top of your library. You have no maximum hand size until your next turn.

cards.name: Enter the Unknown
cards.oracleText:
Target creature you control explores. (Reveal the top card of your library. Put that card into your hand if it's a land. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on the creature, then put the card back or put it into your graveyard.)
You may play an additional land this turn.
